method: Weigh the individual pizza base before cooking, using the raw weight listed in the ingredients. Preheat the oven to the temperature stated on its packet. Put a baking tray inside to heat. Keep the base ready on a board; follow any packet instruction to pre-bake it, and use its stated baking time for the final oven stage.
Slice the mixed peppers thinly. Heat half of the measured olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat and cook the peppers for 5–6 minutes until softened; transfer them to a clean bowl.

Cut the lean pork loin across the grain into strips about 1cm thick. Coat with all the measured paprika, chilli powder, garlic powder and dried oregano. After handling raw lean pork loin, wash hands and clean the board, knife and work surface before touching the ready-to-eat ingredients.

Add the remaining half of the measured olive oil to the non-stick frying pan. Cook the pork strips over a medium-high heat for about 7–9 minutes, turning regularly. Check the centre with a clean food thermometer: it must stay at 75°C or above for 30 seconds. Without a thermometer, cut the thickest piece open and check that it is steaming inside with no pink meat and the juices are clear. Continue cooking until these checks are met; the suggested pan time alone is not a safety check.

Transfer the cooked pork strips to the bowl of peppers. Add the measured tomato passata to the empty frying pan and simmer gently for 3–4 minutes, stirring, until slightly thickened so it will not soak the base.

Spread all the thickened tomato passata over the individual pizza base, leaving a narrow border. Arrange the cooked peppers and the cooked pork strips evenly on top. Carefully slide onto the hot tray.
Bake for the pizza base packet's stated time, until the dough is cooked through, the base is crisp underneath and the topping is hot throughout. Rest for one minute, cut and serve.

review.notes: Cooked pork loin strips and softened peppers over passata on an individual golden pizza base, with cooked dried-spice coating and no cheese or extra sauce. One plausible serving with central food retained by responsive cropping.
